value.rationale: The sector half-angle is a natural geometric constraint interpolating real-positive and right-half-plane harmonic traces, motivated directly by a newly sharp unrestricted coefficient theorem. The exact parameter threshold at pi/4 is not a cosmetic normalization: extremizer support changes from one cosine half-wave to two, and critical angles support a continuous family of geometries. The result supplies all exact constants and all equality cases for every Fourier order in a natural h^2 subclass, without arbitrary finite slices.
